user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a GeoPackage census tract layer covering State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough. Treat the result as a candidate and retain its runtime metadata for downstream validation.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify every census tract that intersects the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the census tract candidate layer and the supplied borough boundary using intersection as the spatial predicate. Retain the census tract features that intersect the borough boundary; do not guess or specify field names.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean DEM elevation for each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation using the supplied full-coverage DEM as the raster and the intersecting census tracts as polygon zones. Preserve a tract identifier in the output table where available; ground any required runtime field names from observed schemas rather than guessing.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census tract candidate layer must cover State College borough so all intersecting census tracts can be selected.
Census tract and borough polygon geometries must be valid for spatial intersection.
Census tract and borough layers must use compatible CRSs for the spatial intersection join.
The DEM and intersecting census tract polygons must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The selected DEM must cover the spatial extent of all census tracts intersecting State College borough.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.
